thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High latency detected for text-generation model 'redwood-13b-v3' in us-west-2 (hosted). Alerting oncall @alex. Severity: P1 -> elevated customer impact for some API keys. War room: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210

alex: I'm on it. joining war room now — will own initial triage.

mira: joining. I'll pull infra metrics (GPU load, network, autoscaler).

jordan: eng-runtime here. I'll check the last deploy and kernel selection logs. Not seeing recent deploys in the past hour but will confirm.

sam: support/ops — starting a customer list query to find impacted API keys and open a draft notification.

chris: which customers? internal dashboards show a spike in 95th percentile for `/v1/generate` in us-west-2 but not other regions.

alex: early signal looks limited to redwood-13b-v3 routes in us-west-2. Running quick query to list keys hitting >50% p99 latency:```sql
SELECT api_key, org_id, count(*) as errors, avg(latency_p95) as p95
FROM request_metrics
WHERE region = 'us-west-2' AND model = 'redwood-13b-v3' AND timestamp > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY api_key, org_id
ORDER BY p95 DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

mira: infra snapshot: GPU utilization 98% on several nodes, pod restart count low. Autoscaler hasn't spun additional nodes in last 10m. Possible scheduling bottleneck or queue backlog.

jordan: runtime logs showing repeated KV cache eviction warnings and a flurry of `cudaMemoryError` traces around 09:12 UTC. Pasting truncated logs:```
2026-03-15T09:11:58Z runtime: evicting kv cache entry for model:redwood-13b-v3 shard:2
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z runtime: error allocating tensor, cudaMemoryError: out of memory
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z runtime: falling back to smaller kernel path; increased latency observed
```

alex: ok, hypothesis: memory pressure on GPU drivers -> OOMs -> fallback kernels -> latency spike. Mitigation options: 1) temporarily route traffic for redwood-13b-v3 -> redwood-7b-v1 for affected orgs, 2) force-evict long-lived KV caches, 3) scale up dedicated nodes (but may take minutes).

mira: I can trigger a horizontal scale to add 4 nodes in us-west-2 (cloud autoscale API) — ETA ~3-5 min. Doing it now. Command:```bash
# trigger scale
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $AUTOSCALE_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood-infra.internal/scale -d '{\"region\":\"us-west-2\",\"add_nodes\":4}'
```

jordan: I'll prepare a routing rollback rule to shift traffic for the affected route to redwood-7b-v1 as a temporary fallback. Draft rule:```yaml
- match: route == \"/v1/generate\" and model == \"redwood-13b-v3\"
  condition: latency_p95 > 2s
  action: route_to: redwood-7b-v1
  ttl: 15m
```

sam: I'll draft a public status update and a customer DM template. Post to status page? yes, we should publish now to inform customers. Draft status page:```text
Status: Investigating
Component: Hosted API - us-west-2 (text generation)
Impact: Some customers may experience increased latency or timeouts when using redwood-13b-v3.
What we're doing: Our on-call and runtime teams are investigating. We're scaling capacity and preparing a fallback routing rule to reduce impact.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a mitigation to report.
```

emily: I'll publish the status page update and include the regions tag. Please send me the final copy to post (I'll wait for confirmation).

chris: customer notification DM draft (to be sent to impacted org owners):```text
Hi — we're investigating elevated latency for our text-generation model redwood-13b-v3 in us-west-2. We may reroute your traffic to a smaller model (redwood-7b-v1) to restore responsiveness. We will update you in ~15 minutes and will notify when we restore normal performance. Sorry for the disruption.
```

alex: assigning incident lead = alex (oncall). responders: mira (infra), jordan (runtime), sam (support/customer comms), emily (status page). War room pinned: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210

mira: scale API returned success, new nodes provisioning. Watching node join events.

jordan: routing rule staged in config service in `staging` mode. I'll promote to `active` if autoscale doesn't relieve pressure in 5 minutes.

sam: sending DM draft to impacted customers now. Posting notes to incident tracker.

incidents-bot: ACTION: statuspage published by emily at 2026-03-15T09:13:10Z — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-15-ww84

emily: published. Shared to twitter and status subscribers.

alex: quick mitigation applied: promoted routing rule to divert 30% of traffic to redwood-7b-v1 for affected orgs to reduce tail latency while we scale. Monitoring playback.

mira: new nodes joined the cluster, autoscaler reports headroom increasing. GPU memory pressure dropping on the busiest shards.

jordan: latency p95 trending down, traces show fewer `cudaMemoryError` after fallback in place. Still watching for tail errors.

chris: support queue — informing top-10 impacted customers now. Sending individual DMs for any customers with high-volume SLAs.

alex: plan: 1) continue monitoring until p95 stable < 1s for 30m, 2) revert fallback routing after stability, 3) follow up with root cause analysis. Next update in 30 minutes or on recovery.

mira: noted. leaving a checklist item to capture GPU driver and runtime state for RCA.

jordan: will capture runtime dumps and attach to the incident doc. command used:```bash
# collect runtime dump
kubectl exec -n inference ${POD} -- /usr/local/bin/dump-runtime-state --out /tmp/runtime-dump.tar.gz
kubectl cp ${POD}:/tmp/runtime-dump.tar.gz ./runtime-dump.tar.gz
```

alex: thanks all. continuing hands-on. ping here for any immediate asks. :thumbsup:
